Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 1996
ACT I OF 1996
SINDH REGISTRATION OF , GODOWNS ACT, 1995
1. Short title and commencement. ‑‑‑(I)
This Act may be called the Sindh
Registration of Godowns Act, 1995.
(2) It shall extend to the whole of the Province of
Sindh.
(3) It shall come into force at once.

Definitions

ACT I OF 1996
ACT I OF 1996
SINDH REGISTRATION OF , GODOWNS ACT, 1995
2. Definition.‑‑‑In this act;
unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context‑‑‑
(i) "essential article" means an article
declared as such by Government;
(ii) "godown" means premises used for
storing of an essential article and includes ware house, cold storage or depot;
(iii) "Government"
means the Government of Sindh;
(iv) "Owner" means an owner of a godown and
includes the person having the management of a godown;
(v) "prescribed"
means prescribed by rules made under this Act.
(vi) "Registering Authority" means the
Director General Bureau of Supply and Prices or any other officer appointed as
such by Government.

Stocking of essential articles

ACT I OF 1996
ACT I OF 1996
SINDH REGISTRATION OF , GODOWNS ACT, 1995
3. Stocking of essential articles.‑‑‑No
essential article shall be stored or stocked in a godown unless the godown is
registered in accordance with the provisions of this Act.

Registration of Godown

ACT I OF 1996
ACT I OF 1996
SINDH REGISTRATION OF , GODOWNS ACT, 1995
4. Registration of Godown.‑‑‑(1)
The owner shall, within thirty days of the commencement of this Act, in the
case of a godown already in existence and within sixty days of the construction
or establishment of new godown, make an application to the Registering
Authority in the prescribed form for registration of his godown.
(2) The Registering Authority, on receipt of the
application shall make such inquiries, and require the owner to furnish such information
as he considers necessary.
(3) If the Registering Authority as a result of such
inquiry made by it, is satisfied that the information contained in the
application or furnished by the owner in respect of his godown is correct, it
shall register the godown.
(4) The owner whose godown is registered shall be
responsible for due compliance with the provisions of this Act and the rules
and with the directions, if any, issued to him by the Registering Authority in
respect of the godown or the essential article stored therein.

Maintenance and inspection of records

ACT I OF 1996
ACT I OF 1996
SINDH REGISTRATION OF , GODOWNS ACT, 1995
5. Maintenance
and inspection of records.‑‑‑The owner shall maintain and
produce for inspection of such books, accounts and record relating to the
essential articles stored in or removed from the godown and to furnish such
information relating thereto as may be required by the Registering Authority.

Power of search

ACT I OF 1996
ACT I OF 1996
SINDH REGISTRATION OF , GODOWNS ACT, 1995
6. Power of Search.‑‑‑The
Registering Authority may enter and search the godown registered under this Act
and seize any essential article in respect of which the Authority has reasons
to believe that the information furnished by the owner is not correct or the
directions issued by the Registering Authority are being or are about to be
contravened:

Appeal

ACT I OF 1996
ACT I OF 1996
SINDH REGISTRATION OF , GODOWNS ACT, 1995
7. Appeal.‑‑‑Any person aggrieved
by an order of the Registering Authority, may within thirty days of the order
appeal to Government and the orders passed by the Government thereon shall be
final.

Penalty

ACT I OF 1996
ACT I OF 1996
SINDH REGISTRATION OF , GODOWNS ACT, 1995
8. Penalty. ‑Whoever contravenes any provision
of this Act or order made or directions given by the Registering Authority
shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year or
with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees.

9. Power to make rules.‑‑‑Government
may make rules to give effect to the provisions of this Act.

Repeal of Sindh Ordinance X of 1995

ACT I OF 1996
ACT I OF 1996
SINDH REGISTRATION OF , GODOWNS ACT, 1995
10. Repeal of Sindh Ordinance X of 1995.‑‑‑The
Sindh Registration of Godowns Ordinance, 1995, is hereby repealed.
